primary_anchor_zh: 清楚分开的四只大型陶土罐
story_reason_zh: 陶罐被搬去晾晒，随后放回窑房台面

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 一组大型陶土罐在陶坊窑房的宽台面上，陶罐表面保持柔和侧光。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 陶罐表面保持柔和侧光
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 清楚分开的四只大型陶土罐占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 陶工缓慢推动装有四只陶罐的低车离开窑房画面；随后呈现空宽台面和后方砖墙。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 陶工缓慢推动装有四只陶罐的低车离开窑房画面
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 离场动作与原有故事原因对应，动作缓慢、短距离，镜头保持固定。

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 陶工缓慢将装有四只分开陶罐的低车推回工作台旁
shot_design.main_action_zh: 陶工缓慢将装有四只分开陶罐的低车推回工作台旁
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 清楚呈现清楚分开的四只大型陶土罐；不要求复现精确排列。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed wide shot frames four large clay jars, clearly separated across the work surface in a brick-walled kiln room. Soft side light reveals their broad forms.

A fixed wide shot shows four large clay jars, clearly separated across the work surface in a brick-walled kiln room. A potter slowly rolls a low trolley holding all four clay jars through the kiln-room doorway and out of frame. The fixed camera then holds on the empty wide work surface and the brick wall behind it. Dust motes drift through the high-window light.

A fixed wide shot holds on the empty wide work surface and the brick wall behind it. A potter slowly rolls a low trolley holding four large separated clay jars back into frame and stops it beside the work surface.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 陶工缓慢推动装有四只陶罐的低车离开窑房画面
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 陶工缓慢将装有四只分开陶罐的低车推回工作台旁
transition_design.design_note_zh: Shot 2 在固定镜头内先展示自然离场，再保留背景；Shot 3 用对应动作让主体回到画面。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
